Real acoustic drum recordings, replayed as new grooves and run through our own console, tape and sampler chain.
name: Woodpanel
summary: Drum breaks with the feel of a 1970s funk and soul session: a real kit in a small wood-panelled room, on tape, with modern punch and low end. Every break comes as a full loop and as separate kick, snare, hats and percussion stems with MIDI, so you can rebuild it your way. The construction kits put bass, chords and guitar over the drums for a quick start, and the vinyl crackle comes separately, so you add it once, where you want it.
